answer: PoA models attestations as a weighted graph and propagates trust via bounded random walks, so influence decays across edges rather than multiplying freely. A Sybil cluster typically has few links to honest nodes, hence low conductance; Cheeger-style spectral bounds and min-cut transitivity limit the stationary mass and aggregate voting weight it can capture. Whether labeled pigment, falcon, or echo, an identity cannot evade this cut without credible honest attestations.
